text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Bus Services Industry (Bus Depot and Bus Interchange Licence) Regulations 2016.

heading.en: Fee for fresh or renewed bus depot licence or bus interchange licence

text.en:

heading.en: Time to apply for licence renewal

text.en: 3. An application to the LTA for the renewal of a bus depot licence or bus interchange licence must be made in writing in the form and manner required by the LTA, and no later than 6 months before the expiry of the licence.
